137        public CampaignFleetAPI createFleet(StarSystemAPI system, Random random) {
138        
139                float f = intel.getMarketPresenceFactor(system);
140                
141                int difficulty = 4 + (int) Math.round(f * 4f);
142                
143                FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
144                m.beginFleet();
145                
146                Vector2f loc = system.getLocation();
147                String factionId = Factions.DIKTAT;
148                
149                m.createQualityFleet(difficulty, factionId, loc);
150                
151                m.triggerSetFleetType(FleetTypes.RAIDER);
152                
153                m.triggerSetPirateFleet();
154                m.triggerMakeHostile();
155                m.triggerMakeNonHostileToFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
156                m.triggerMakeNonHostileToFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
157                m.triggerMakeLowRepImpact();
158                m.triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
159                m.triggerMakeHostileToAllTradeFleets();
160                m.triggerMakeEveryoneJoinBattleAgainst();
161                
162                m.triggerSetFleetFlag(RAIDER_FLEET);
163                
164                m.triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, 0, true);
165                
166                //m.triggerSetFleetMaxShipSize(3);
167                
168                
169                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = m.createFleet();
170
171                return fleet;
172        }

245        public static Industry getSindrianFuelProd() {
246                MarketAPI sindria = getSindria(false);
247                if (sindria == null) return null;
248                
249                Industry prod = sindria.getIndustry(Industries.FUELPROD);
250                return prod;
251        }
252        
253        public static MarketAPI getSindria(boolean requireMilitaryBase) {
254                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
255                if (sindria == null || sindria.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED) ||
256                                !sindria.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) {
257                        return null;
258                }
259                if (requireMilitaryBase) {
260                        Industry b = sindria.getIndustry(Industries.MILITARYBASE);
261                        if (b == null) b = sindria.getIndustry(Industries.HIGHCOMMAND);
262                        if (b == null || b.isDisrupted() || !b.isFunctional()) {
263                                return null;
264                        }
265                }
266                return sindria;
267        }

269        
270        public float getEventFrequency(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
271                if (stage.id == Stage.HA_EVENT) {
272                        
273                        if (isPlayerDefeatedDiktatAttack() || getSindria(true) == null) {
274                                return 0f;
275                        }
276                        
277                        if (isMadeDeal()) return 0f;
278                        
279                        if (SindrianDiktatPunitiveExpedition.get() != null) {
280                                return 0f;
281                        }
282                        
283                        MarketAPI target = findExpeditionTarget(intel, stage);
284                        MarketAPI source = getSindria(true);
285                        if (target != null && source != null) {
286                                return 10f;
287                        }
288                }
289                return 0;
290        }

296                intel.sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(data, false);

299        public boolean fireEvent(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
300                MarketAPI target = findExpeditionTarget(intel, stage);
301                MarketAPI source = getSindria(true);
302                
303                if (source == null || target == null) {
304                        return false;
305                }
306        
307                stage.rollData = null;
308                return startAttack(source, target, target.getStarSystem(), stage, getRandomizedStageRandom(3));
309        }

311        
312        public static MarketAPI findExpeditionTarget(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
313                List<CompetitorData> data = SindrianDiktatStandardActivityCause.computePlayerCompetitionData();
314                CountingMap<MarketAPI> counts = new CountingMap<MarketAPI>();
315                
316                for (CompetitorData curr : data) {
317                        for (MarketAPI market : curr.competitorProducers) {
318                                StarSystemAPI system = market.getStarSystem();
319                                if (system == null) continue;
320                                int weight = market.getCommodityData(curr.commodityId).getMaxSupply();
321                                counts.add(market, weight);
322                        }
323                }
324                
325                return counts.getLargest();
326        }

378        
379        public boolean startAttack(MarketAPI source, MarketAPI target, StarSystemAPI system, EventStageData stage, Random random) {
380                GenericRaidParams params = new GenericRaidParams(new Random(random.nextLong()), true);
381                
382                params.makeFleetsHostile = false; // will be made hostile when they arrive, not before
383                
384                params.factionId = source.getFactionId();
385                params.source = source;
386                
387                params.prepDays = 14f + random.nextFloat() * 14f;
388                params.payloadDays = 27f + 7f * random.nextFloat();
389                
390                params.raidParams.where = system;
391                params.raidParams.type = FGRaidType.SEQUENTIAL;
392                params.raidParams.tryToCaptureObjectives = false;
393                params.raidParams.allowedTargets.add(target);
394                params.raidParams.allowNonHostileTargets = true;
395                params.raidParams.setBombardment(BombardType.SATURATION);
396                
397                params.style = FleetStyle.STANDARD;
398                
399                
400                // standard Askonia fleet size multiplier with no shortages/issues is a bit over 230%
401                float fleetSizeMult = source.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SIZE_MULT).computeEffective(0f);
402                
403                float f = intel.getMarketPresenceFactor(system);
404                
405                float totalDifficulty = fleetSizeMult * 15f * (0.6f + 0.4f * f);
406                
407                if (totalDifficulty < 15) {
408                        return false;
409                }
410                if (totalDifficulty > 100) {
411                        totalDifficulty = 100;
412                }
413                
414                totalDifficulty -= 10;
415                
416                params.fleetSizes.add(10);
417                
418                while (totalDifficulty > 0) {
419                        int min = 6;
420                        int max = 10;
421                        
422                        //int diff = Math.round(StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(random, min, max));
423                        int diff = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
424                        
425                        params.fleetSizes.add(diff);
426                        totalDifficulty -= diff;
427                }
428                
429                
430                SindrianDiktatPunitiveExpedition punex = new SindrianDiktatPunitiveExpedition(params);
431                punex.setListener(this);
432                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(punex);
433                
434//              GenericRaidFGI raid = new GenericRaidFGI(params);
435//              raid.setListener(this);
436//              Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(raid);
437                
438                return true;
439        }
